name: Bahir Yasreb Seemab
title: Full-Stack Software Engineer
bio: I'm a full-stack software engineer with 5+ years of building for the web — mostly on the frontend, where I care about the small details that make an interface feel right.

I build the backends behind them too: APIs, databases, auth and security. Lately that has meant offline-first lockdown software, a zero-knowledge password manager and an AI coach that makes you earn your scroll time.
I'm open to remote work anywhere in the world — the plan is to see a lot of it while I work.
Away from the keyboard: chess, books, football, guitar and flute, and a lot of time outdoors. One day, a moose.
